substitutions.new:
$script:TestState = @{ $StockProductCode = $true; $CandidateProductCode = $false; WslConfig = $false; WslDebugConsole = $false }
    $script:Actions = [Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
    $script:FailAt = $null
    Invoke-Transaction
    $candidateProbeCount = @($script:Actions | Where-Object { $_ -eq 'candidate-probe' }).Count
    if ($candidateProbeCount -ne $ColdStartCount -or @($script:Actions | Where-Object { $_ -eq 'recovery-probe' }).Count -ne 1) { throw 'Self-test did not execute exactly ten candidate probes and one recovery probe.' }
    $script:TestState = $null
    [pscustomobject][ordered]@{ schema = 1; selfTest = $true; passed = $true; coldStarts = $candidateProbeCount; failurePaths = $results } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 -Compress

substitutions.old: note = 'Fixture-local kernel comparison with unchanged minimal-v8 control plane and diagnostic capture; the preserved no-overlay kernel/config pair is the sole experimental delta, and transport, extraction, and ledger finalization remain external prerequisites.'
substitutions.new: note = 'Fixture-local ten-cold-start acceptance of the unchanged retained candidate. Each serial start uses the exact fixed Toybox probe, 45-second process timeout, diagnostic instrumentation, and shutdown; exact stock recovery remains mandatory.'

substitutions.old: if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $EvidenceParent $TrialId)) { throw "Candidate evidence root already exists for $TrialId." }
foreach ($path in @((Join-Path $evidenceParent $Trial),(Join-Path $evidenceParent $Recovery))) { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path) { throw "Reserved evidence path exists: $path" } }
substitutions.new: foreach ($id in @($StartIds) + @($Recovery)) { $path = Join-Path $evidenceParent $id; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path) { throw "Reserved evidence path exists: $path" } }
if (-not $selfTest.passed -or $selfTest.coldStarts -ne 10 -or @($selfTest.failurePaths).Count -ne 19) { throw 'Runner fault matrix or cold-start cardinality self-test failed.' }
if (-not $validation.validated -or $validation.execute -or -not $validation.diagnosticDebugConsole -or $validation.coldStartCount -ne 10) { throw 'Runner diagnostic acceptance validation failed.' }

substitutions.old: if ($remote.stockProductState -ne 5 -or $remote.candidateProductState -eq 5 -or $remote.wslconfigExists -or $remote.diagnosticRelayCount -ne 0 -or -not $remote.recoveryResult -or -not $remote.recoveryResult.passed) { throw 'Independent stock recovery and diagnostic cleanup requirement failed.' }
substitutions.new: if ($remote.stockProductState -ne 5 -or $remote.candidateProductState -eq 5 -or $remote.wslconfigExists -or $remote.diagnosticRelayCount -ne 0 -or $remote.coldStartCount -ne 10 -or @($remote.candidateResults | Where-Object { -not $_.result -or -not $_.result.passed }).Count -ne 0 -or -not $remote.recoveryResult -or -not $remote.recoveryResult.passed) { throw 'Ten-start acceptance, independent stock recovery, or diagnostic cleanup requirement failed.' }
